research_findings: Analyzed the ultimate-sd codebase and found a missing rate limiter for the waitlist signup feature (src/app/actions/waitlist.ts).
Discovered an issue with React hooks usage in src/components/landing/AdaptiveCoachDemo.tsx where a ref value was accessed during render, causing eslint to fail.
features_improved: Refactored src/components/landing/AdaptiveCoachDemo.tsx to correctly use useState instead of useRef for `preferReducedMotion`, which resolved the React hooks linting error.
Optimized waitlist feature by preventing potential DDOS / spam abuse through rate limiting.
new_features_added: Integrated `@upstash/ratelimit` and `@upstash/redis` into the project to implement IP-based rate limiting on the `joinWaitlist` server action.
next_steps_for_next_run: Add comprehensive unit tests for the new rate limiting logic.
Consider generalizing the rate limiter to other public facing actions to further enhance system security.
